services.title: Web & SaaS products
services.summary: I build the whole product: database, API, admin panel and frontend. The architecture is defined before the first line of code, typing is strict end to end, and deployment runs on your own infrastructure — no platform lock-in.
points: **Architecture first** — data flow and scalability designed before any code
**Real performance** — server rendering, indexed queries, zero dead weight
**Data that holds** — ACID transactions, roles and an audit trail on every operation
**Your own infrastructure** — Docker, nginx and CI/CD on your VPS or your cloud

services.title: Offline-first mobile apps
services.summary: Offline-first synchronization is my specialty. Field apps — logistics, technicians, events, mountain trails — lose signal constantly. Mine store every operation locally, queue it, and sync it in chronological order the moment connectivity returns. The user never sees a network error.
points: **Zero data loss** — local persistence with Room or SQLite and reactive sync queues
**Advanced geolocation** — maps, geofences and proximity search with PostGIS and Mapbox
**Native where it counts** — Kotlin and Swift when performance or hardware demand it
**Proof from the field** — photos, signatures, printed tickets, full traceability

services.title: Applied AI & algorithms
services.summary: I bring AI in where it moves the number, not where it looks good: agents with strict output validation, models running inside the user's browser at zero API cost, and mathematical engines in C++ for fleet routing and optimization.
points: **AI without hallucinations** — every claim mechanically validated against the source
**Zero token cost** — models running on the user's device, with full privacy
**Mathematical optimization** — TSP and VRPTW solved in milliseconds with C++20
**Wired into the operation** — the AI connects to your data and processes, not the other way around

featured.name: Cappy
featured.summary: Geolocated trades marketplace for LATAM. Users describe a problem in plain language and an LLM layer picks the right trade and the best nearby professionals — measured against a custom eval set of real queries.
highlights: Built solo: mobile app, backend, payments, infra, trademark
Real-time proximity matching with PostgreSQL + PostGIS
Launching on the App Store and Google Play

featured.name: Calei — OrionLogistics
featured.summary: B2B SaaS for delivery and distribution management, in production powering the daily operations of a distribution company.
highlights: A C++20 routing engine on Vroom + OSRM cut route calculation by 95%
Offline-first Android app: every operation queued locally and synced in order
Multi-tenant: JWT tenant id, Postgres Row-Level Security, seeded roles, 50+ features

featured.name: Hipólito
featured.summary: An educational chat that runs a full language model **inside the browser**. Nothing is sent to an API, inference costs nothing per message, and the student's conversation never leaves their device.
highlights: Client-side inference with Transformers.js — no inference server to pay for or secure
Full privacy by construction rather than by policy
The most openly readable thing I have built: the source is public

featured.name: B2B point-of-sale
featured.summary: Sales and inventory system for B2B retail, designed for scale across GCP and Azure, with client-side AI running on the shop's own Android hardware.
highlights: TensorFlow Lite on device, so the shop floor keeps working without connectivity
Java 21 + Spring Boot behind a Next.js front end

experience.note: Boutique studio delivering custom software, cross-platform apps and production AI integrations, with a designer and a software engineer/PM.

A year of professional full-stack work on a property rental platform: Next.js frontends, NestJS APIs with strict DTO validation, AWS S3 hardened with IAM, and SQL tuning that cut latency on complex searches.
8+ clients over 2–4 month project lifecycles; hardened Linux VPS fleets with zero security incidents.
